// --- Start of generated code for the 257-gon ---

// This array will hold the vertices of the polygon.
// We start with E and H3.
const vertices = ["E", "H3"];

// Generate commands to create the other 255 vertices.
// We start from H4.
for (let i = 1; i <= 255; i++) {
  const prevVertex = vertices[i];
  const lastVertex = vertices[i-1];
  const newVertex = `H${i + 3}`;
  
  commands.push(`circle(oo${i},${prevVertex},${lastVertex})`);
  commands.push(`intercept(${newVertex},oo${i},c4,1)`);
  
  vertices.push(newVertex);
}

// Generate commands to draw the 257 segments (sides).
for (let i = 1; i < vertices.length; i++) {
    const p1 = vertices[i-1];
    const p2 = vertices[i];
    commands.push(`segment(sd${i},${p1},${p2})`);
}
// Add the last segment to close the polygon.
commands.push(`segment(sd257,${vertices[vertices.length-1]},${vertices[0]})`);

// --- End of generated code ---


let i = 0;
function runNextCommand() {
  if (i >= commands.length) {
    plotter.message('作图完成!', 5000);
    return;
  }

  const command = commands[i];
  // Default color values and visibility
  let h = 0, s = 0, b = 0, a = 80, visible = 1;
  
  if (command.startsWith('point') || command.startsWith('intercept')) {
    // Black color for points
    h = 0; s = 0; b = 0;
  } else if (command.startsWith('circle')) {
    // Light blue for circles
    h = 58; s = 40; b = 100;
  } else if (command.startsWith('line')) {
    // Light purple for lines
    h = 83; s = 40; b = 100;
  } else if (command.startsWith('segment')) {
    // Segments for the 257-gon are black and opaque
    h = 0; s = 0; b = 0; a = 0;
  }

  plotter.creategeo(command, h, s, b, a, visible);
  
  i++;
  setTimeout(runNextCommand, 50);
}

runNextCommand();
